Wait, That's Weird Al? GTA 6's Radio Hosts, From Vice City FM to Slayer 🍔📻

carousel // Nov 20, 2026

See it on Instagram

You hear Weird Al on Vice City FM. Then a Burger Shot ad comes on, and somehow you're still listening to Weird Al. 🍔📻

GTA radio has always been half the fun, and GTA 6's dial is stacked. Here's who you're actually hearing.

Vice City FM: that's DJ Al

"Weird Al" Yankovic hosts Vice City FM as DJ Al, with Brigitte Nielsen co-hosting as Madame Brigitte. Rockstar's GTA VI credits

The Burger Shot guy? Also Weird Al

Al confirmed he voiced the Burger Shot ads, and he says he wrote some of the game's commercials too, so his credit goes beyond the burgers. The A.V. Club on Al's announcement

The rest of the dial

  • Kaleidoscope FM: Jeremy Irons as DJ Dicky.
  • Honey FM: T-Boz and Chilli of TLC, hosting as themselves.
  • The Chamber 106.6: Slayer's Kerry King as DJ Kerry and Tom Araya as DJ Tom, with Brian Posehn as Big Fan Brian.

All from Rockstar's credits. This roundup covers the featured stations' main hosts, not every voice in the game. Rockstar's GTA VI credits

The carousel art is AI-assisted editorial illustration of imagined scenes, not in-game screenshots or photos of the performers.

The seven posted slides

Quick answers

Who hosts Vice City FM in GTA 6? "Weird Al" Yankovic as DJ Al, with Brigitte Nielsen as Madame Brigitte.

Is Weird Al in the Burger Shot ads? Yes. He confirmed he voiced them and wrote some of the game's commercials.

Is Slayer in GTA 6? Kerry King and Tom Araya host The Chamber 106.6 as DJ Kerry and DJ Tom.
